body.title: The git-calls helper module
body.summary: Add src/workflow/git-calls.ts with the helpers the sites use (revParse, catFileExists, lsFiles, pathHistory, configGet, lsRemote, fetchRefs, forEachRef, remoteUrl, statusPaths, rootCommits and those t1 adds) built on run/must/soft and workflowToolDeps of src/workflow/tracker/registry-table.ts, plus GitCallFailed. Each helper takes the site's cwd, signal, timeout and approval mode and returns the plain value the old code used; a denial is thrown as ToolDenied and a schema or conversion failure is thrown, never a fallback.
acceptanceChecks: each helper calls its tool through callTool with the caller 'workflow' and the site's signal and approval mode
each tool failure kind maps to the site fallback or to GitCallFailed as the LLD's error paths say; a denial with each reason is thrown as ToolDenied
no helper has a catch that swallows ToolDenied

tests.name: git-calls.test.ts: each helper calls its tool through callTool with the caller 'workflow', the site's signal and approval mode
git-calls.test.ts: each failure kind maps to the site fallback or GitCallFailed and a denial with each reason is thrown as ToolDenied
